title: Wikidata:Licensing
reuse: The page says all structured data is released into the public domain under Creative Commons Zero, and that text in other namespaces is under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 License.
taken: For 399 ingredients, preparations and dishes: the Wikidata item id, matched by exact English label to a food or food ingredient (320), or chosen by a person from a list of items of any class whose description sounds like a food (79), and the item's label in Spanish, Italian, Turkish and French where it was a plain name. Matches through an alias, labels with two items, and names in other scripts were left out. Labels are crowd-written and unreviewed, so the names stay drafted. A search of its properties for the word allergen returned none, so it has no ready statement of which allergen a food holds.
